name: github

repo.description: owner/name; required for create, clone, and fork targets.

hostname.description: GitHub Enterprise DNS name; default github.com.

id.description: Run, release, or notification thread id.

owner.description: repo.list owner; omit for authenticated repositories.

destination.description: repo.clone only: explicit absolute new directory with an existing parent.

sha.description: Full PR head commit hash; review/merge only.

workflow.description: workflow.run target or run.list filter: workflow file name or numeric id as text.

ref.description: Explicit branch/tag to dispatch workflow on.

description: GitHub repositories, issues, PRs and reviews, Actions/logs, releases, and notifications through the signed-in GitHub CLI. Local Git history/diffs/staging belong to git. One action per call; writes are serialized and never retried. Obtain user approval before writes; workflow runs and published releases may deploy. repo is owner/name; omit to resolve the current Project. Lists use page/limit and return compact rows (issues/PRs: number, title, state, author, updated, labels, 140-char excerpt; other lists: ids and status fields); open a row with its *.view action for bodies and details. Review/merge requires the current PR head sha. Install/connect in Extensions → Plugin → Git & GitHub. Results omit API-only URLs and node ids and name users/repos by login/full_name; issue/PR views keep decision fields and cap the body; `raw`, present whenever rows, text or fields were cut or dropped, is a readable file with the full response, and long results state what is shown.
